subject: Exec steer: scope slice, commitment matrix & runway asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, acme-procurement@acme.com, Bethany Cruz <bethany@centaurihealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec steer: scope slice, commitment matrix & runway asks

Team —

We need a quick alignment ahead of next week's QBR. After reviewing the midpoint signals, I recommend we:

1) Narrow feature scope for Q4 delivery to the highest-impact slice (see attached matrix).
2) Freeze noncritical UI polish for the next 6 weeks to reallocate 2 engineers to the serving runtime work.
3) Lock on SLAs for Dedicated customers, and surface any procurement blockers for ACME and Centauri.

Concrete asks (please respond in-thread with owner + date):
- Laura: confirm which two engineers we can reassign from platform UX and proposed backfill plan (due EOD Fri).
- Neha: quick infra impact note for the runtime shift — any infra lead time we should communicate to sales/procurement (due Thu 12:00).
- Vanessa: validate the KPI reductions in tab "Slice A" of the matrix and confirm we can still reach QBR callouts with that scope (due Thu EOD).
- Tessa: if we need to escalate any credits or exceptions for ACME procurement, flag here so I can brief the execs (due Thu 10:00).

Attachments: commitment-matrix-v1.xlsx (named slices + owners), qbr-brief-stub.pdf (two-slide summary).

High-level rationale: the telemetry shows our cost-per-100k tokens trending +12% vs plan; keeping full UI work will push latency / infra spend up and threatens the Dedicated SLA promise. The slice proposed preserves the customer-critical inference throughput improvements and the core developer surface.

If you disagree with a proposed owner or timing, push back here and propose alternatives — I want firm commitments by Fri so sales can lock expectations with ACME / Centauri.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec steer: scope slice, commitment matrix & runway asks

Markus — thanks for the steer. Quick updates:

- Engineers: we can reassign Priya and Daniel from the UI backlog for 6 weeks. Priya will carry over the essential accessibility fixes; Daniel will be backfilled by a contractor (SOW in progress). I estimate a 1-week ramp for the contractor. Owner: Laura (confirm by Fri EOD).
- Backfill risk: risk of a minor regress in the onboarding flow; mitigation is a focused test pass and a customer-facing note.

Action items I need from others:
- Neha: confirm infra lead time for the KV cache capacity changes (this will determine when we can start shifting requests to the dedicated pools).
- Vanessa: confirm KPIs in the matrix (I looked at Slice A; some metric names changed and the doc had a stale column).

I uploaded a short backfill plan and the contractor SOW link to the Drive folder (see thread link).

Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec steer: scope slice, commitment matrix & runway asks

Agree with the slice — Slice A preserves the metrics sales is promising. Quick notes:

- KPI cleanup: I fixed the column mapping and annotated assumptions in the matrix (rows 3-8). No change to top-line targets; only removed the noncritical telemetry dashboards from Q4 deliverables.
- Sales comms: Bethany (Centauri) is already asking for a firm date on Dedicated SLA backing. I propose we give them a soft target of Nov 30 and say we will confirm by Nov 10 after infra confirms lead time.

Open issue: ACME procurement has a standard data-retention clause that conflicts with our default retention settings. Tessa, can you check if we should accept a 13-month retention (ACME asks) or push for 6 months? If ACME insists, we will need legal + privacy signoff and that will shift timelines.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick summary and decisions so we have a single source of truth before QBR: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Scope: we will proceed with Slice A for Q4 delivery. KPI footprint locked as revised by Vanessa.
- Staffing: Laura to reassign Priya + Daniel; contractor SOW approved to cover onboarding gap.
- Infra: Neha to confirm KV cache capacity lead time by Thu 12:00 — if lead time >3 weeks we will notify sales and offer a staged SLA (best-effort + targeted SLA Nov 30).
- Procurement: Tessa to push ACME retention negotiation; if ACME requires 13 months we route to legal and surface impact immediately.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Laura: Finalize backfill plan + send candidate info (Due Fri EOD).
- Neha: Infra impact note + earliest deployment window (Due Thu 12:00).
- Vanessa: Final QBR talking points and updated two-slide summary (I attached the revised QBR brief).
- Tessa: Procurement negotiation status + legal flag if needed (Due Thu 10:00).

I've uploaded an updated commitment-matrix-v1.1.xlsx to the Drive folder and pasted the link below. Please do not edit the master — comment inline and I'll merge changes.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR_tray/commitment-matrix
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/companies/ACME-4452 (ACME procurement contact updated)

I'll brief the execs at 2pm PT today with these commitments. If anything changes before then, reply ASAP.

Markus
VP Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
